<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level3/version2/core" level="3" version="2">
  <model id="synthetic_ode" name="synthetic_ode" timeUnits="minute">
    <listOfUnitDefinitions>
      <unitDefinition id="minute">
        <listOfUnits>
          <unit kind="second" exponent="1" scale="0" multiplier="60"/>
        </listOfUnits>
      </unitDefinition>
    </listOfUnitDefinitions>
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="C" spatialDimensions="0" size="1" units="dimensionless" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="r" value="0.8" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K" value="2" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="X" value="0.2" units="dimensionless" constant="false"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfRules>
      <rateRule variable="X">
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
          <apply>
            <times/>
            <ci> r </ci>
            <ci> X </ci>
            <apply>
              <minus/>
              <cn type="integer"> 1 </cn>
              <apply>
                <divide/>
                <ci> X </ci>
                <ci> K </ci>
              </apply>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </math>
      </rateRule>
    </listOfRules>
  </model>
</sbml>
